summary: A beautifully directed desk with no cards on it: ios/App/deals.json was never generated, Pack.load() returns .empty, every lay() fails silently, and the table, win, first deal, both filmstrips and all four ladder panels are the same false 'Today's is in the diary' screen.
fixes: Run node apps/solitaire/tools/pack.mjs and commit ios/App/deals.json; confirm deals.json is inside Baize.app before any capture.
Never show DoneToday unless todayState is .out; a lay() that finds no deal must not be dressed as a finished day.

Re-run every capture after the pack lands: 03-table must show cards, 05 the ghost hand, 02 the fans with 118 MOVES, moment-move and moment-win must change frame to frame, and the ladder panels must differ in grade, draw, mark and cloth.
Set the Diary, Drawer and Settings large titles in New York Semibold in ink instead of the system's black SF.
At the largest text size keep the done state's and win's one action on screen: scale No. and the 96 pt count with minimumScaleFactor or step them down at accessibility sizes.
Make -sampleData actually seed the 23-entry October page so the first App Store screenshot is the diary the spec promised, not the empty state.
Give the paywall its 'Leave it shut' dismissal as DESIGN.md names it, instead of the bare X.
